title: Volvelle Configuration Schema
description: Schema for volvelle YAML configuration files

hierarchy.description: Ordered list of column names defining the grouping hierarchy, outermost first

derived.description: Named map of derived (post-aggregation) field definitions

filters.description: Named map of filter definitions to create data facets

col.description: Name of the source column in the data frame

weight.description: Weight column name, required when fn = weighted_mean

label.description: Display label for the measure column in the widget

expr.description: R expression using measure names as variables

label.description: Display label for the derived column in the widget

val.description: Value(s) to compare against; array for %in%, scalar otherwise

time_var.description: Declares a time/period dimension for side-by-side comparison. The column is included in every ROLLUP grouping set (never aggregated over). After aggregation the result is pivoted wide so each period becomes its own column group.

col.description: Name of the column containing period labels (e.g. 'quarter', 'year').

periods.description: Explicit ordered list of period values. Controls column order in the wide output. Periods absent from the data are silently ignored. If omitted, all unique values are used in ascending sort order.

derived_deltas.description: When true and exactly two periods are present, append a '<measure>_delta' column (period2 - period1) for every measure and derived field. Default false.
